runSummary.note: Real 16 Sep 16:20 sweep. Twelve independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company/public careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom, Pretlak, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. Pandora eCommerce Operations Assistant was reverified on the canonical Pandora career page and remains a strong BA-area part-time e-commerce fit. Fresh LinkedIn discovery surfaced CoolPeople IT Support Specialist 43678 in Bratislava at 2,000 EUR/month, but the full detail explicitly requires excellent spoken and written English, so it was not promoted. Wolt Support Associate is fresh and remote after one training day in Bratislava but requires minimum B2 English and shift work until 01:00 including weekends. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Shift-window fit score
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Normalize shift burden into a structured score using earliest start, latest finish, weekend frequency and predictability, so remote roles with severe evening/weekend requirements do not outrank more compatible daytime work.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Canonical vs mirror drift detector
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Compare salary, hours, language and location fields between the direct employer career page and job-board mirrors; flag discrepancies for verification and always preserve the canonical employer source as primary when available.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data, job-sources or MASTER is attempted where full round-trip content cannot be guaranteed.
